job_text:
DevOps Engineer - Summit Cloud

About the role
Our infrastructure team keeps dozens of services running reliably. You will automate deployments and improve how we monitor production systems.

Requirements
- 3+ years of experience operating production systems on Linux
- Strong experience with AWS services
- Experience building CI/CD pipelines
- Proficiency writing automation scripts in Python or Bash
- Experience with infrastructure as code using Terraform

Nice to have
- Experience with Kubernetes in production
- Familiarity with monitoring tools like Prometheus
- Exposure to Go

Benefits
- Competitive salary
- On-call stipend
